result.why: The hydraulic pressure on CNC-02 shows a persistent downward trend (E4, E8, E11) with no recovery toward ~60 bar during idle periods, consistent with a seal leak (E2). Other hydraulic-equipped machines (CNC-05, CNC-07) maintain steady pressure (E5, E6), ruling out a systemic issue. The alarm at tick 1041 (E7) and the lack of inspection rejects (E9, E12, E16) do not contradict this, as the leak may not yet have caused quality issues. The manual (§2.15) explicitly states that a seal leak worsens while idle, which aligns with the observed trend.

objections.text: No inspection rejects from CNC-02 after the alarm (E9, E12, E16) could indicate the leak is not yet severe enough to affect clamping, but this is a minor gap.
The confidence (0.75) assumes the leak will inevitably cause rejects, but the manual (§2.15) notes some jobs may still pass even with low pressure.
